lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，不出一点声
lines.en: I step on the leaves without a sound
Between the trunks, I drift along
I take a step, then stop for three seconds
In the dark I have no edges

lines.zh: 你回头时，我正好停在树后。
lines.en: When you look back, I'm already still behind a tree.
My legs are thin, but I can run
I press to a trunk and show only half
Not one step lands in the light
I close in, and you have not noticed
A tree shadow shifted, and that was me
No hurry, the road is at your feet

lines.zh: 我从洞穴口慢慢爬出去
lines.en: I crawl slowly out of the cave mouth
I stand like a broken post
My head tilts, yet I do not breathe
Wind goes through me and I do not move
I have measured the gaps between the trees
I simply watch over there
The night is long, and I have patience
I heard you shut the door
Being still is my talent
Moss creeps up around my feet

lines.zh: 窗玻璃上，我的影子很淡。
lines.en: My reflection is faint on the glass.
My fingers are a little too long
I stand at the window with no plan to leave
Abandoned houses hide me well

lines.zh: 我数着你屋里的脚步声
lines.en: I count the footsteps inside your house

lines.zh: 黑暗中我的轮廓不清楚
lines.en: In the dark my outline is unclear
I will keep on waiting
Stare at me and I cannot move
Keep looking, do not look away

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我会近一点
lines.en: When you blink, I get a little closer

lines.zh: 只要你的视线在，我就停着
lines.en: As long as your eyes are on me, I stay still
Do not look back for your friends
Your breathing has quickened

lines.zh: 我在你身后看不见的地方
lines.en: I am behind you, out of sight
Your eyes must be getting tired
You are right not to blink
I am waiting for you to turn your head

lines.zh: 你看见我了，可你还在看
lines.en: You see me, and yet you keep looking

lines.zh: 我一步一步，只在你没看时
lines.en: I only step when you are not looking
You are safe for this second

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段黑暗对望
lines.en: We stare across a stretch of dark
Your hand is reaching for a torch

lines.zh: 光会帮你的，可惜不够亮
lines.en: Light will help you, but it is not bright enough
I am smiling, and you cannot see it
Your shadow moved first

lines.zh: 你眨了一下眼，我就到跟前了。
lines.en: You blinked once, and I am already here.
I retreat without a sound
This wound, I cannot stay still long

lines.zh: 我的皮破了，里面是空的
lines.en: My skin tore, and it is hollow inside

lines.zh: 我歪了一下头，又正回来
lines.en: My head tilts, then rights itself
Pain will not make me leave
Your hand shook, I saw it
I pull back, but not far.

lines.zh: 骨头断了也能重新接上
lines.en: Broken bones can be put back together
That blow brings you one step closer
I do not eat your things
Put the torch down, then we talk
This will not keep me away
You are buying time

lines.zh: 我不需要食物，我需要你没看见我
lines.en: I need no food, I need you not to see me
The light in your hand is the real gift

lines.zh: 放下吧，放下的瞬间我会动
lines.en: Drop it, and the instant you do, I move
I will not take it, I only wait
The more you fear, the closer I get
Put it away, do not waste it
You walked into my arms
There is no warmth in my body
You backed off, and I am still here

lines.zh: 贴着这么近，你看见我了
lines.en: This close, you have seen me
My hand touched your shoulder
You cannot move now, so do not try
I am like a tree, but I close in
What you felt was bone
That step was a mistake
The distance is no longer safe
I am not the only one in this forest
When kin meet, we freeze first

lines.zh: 一起站着，比一起走更常见
lines.en: Standing together is more common than walking
We do not talk, we only stand side by side

lines.zh: 夜里的同伴，不需要名字
lines.en: A companion of the night needs no name

lines.zh: 两个影子，比一个更难发现
lines.en: Two shadows are harder to spot than one
I edge closer, and it does not flinch
We guard the same line of trees

lines.zh: 彼此不动，也是一种约定
lines.en: Both staying still is a kind of pact

lines.zh: 有伴的时候，盯人的活分一半
lines.en: With a mate, the watching is shared
I pick it up, my fingers too long

lines.zh: 这东西是你的还是我的
lines.en: Is this yours or mine
I lift it close to my eyes.
I do not need it, yet I took it
I always reach dropped things first
I grip it tight and do not let go
It has gone cold, like me
Does this count as yours
I set it under the roots

lines.zh: 拿走之后，你少了件东西
lines.en: Take it, and you are one thing poorer

lines.zh: 你移开视线的那一刻，我动了。
lines.en: The moment you look away, I move.
The one behind the tree, that is you
Taking this path suits me

lines.zh: 我一直在等一个落单的
lines.en: I was waiting for someone alone
This stretch of forest is mine
You looked back, and I noted it
The distance is right, I start following
The warmth off you is easy to track
No more hiding needed now
My head turns toward you
Walking faster will not help
The lamp is out, my turn

lines.zh: 你成了今晚唯一的目标
lines.en: You are tonight's only target
I know the length of your stride

lines.zh: 从现在起，你身后一直有我
lines.en: From now on, I am always behind you
I will not call out, and I will not stop

lines.zh: 你每走三步，我靠近一步
lines.en: Every three steps of yours, I take one
Did you hear that branch snap
I cling to the edge of your sight

lines.zh: 别转身，转身就看见我了
lines.en: Do not turn, you would see me
You raised the torch, good
I know this forest better than you
The way you are going has no exit
I am at your window already

lines.zh: 你数着心跳，我数着步子
lines.en: You count heartbeats, I count steps

lines.zh: 你看不见的地方我都去过
lines.en: I have been everywhere you cannot see
My shadow is longer than the trees'
Each step you take brings me ten closer.

lines.zh: 再走一段，你就到我家了
lines.en: A little further and you reach my home
Your lamp oil is running low
I stay silent, and it works better

lines.zh: 你身后的叶子一直在动
lines.en: The leaves behind you keep moving

lines.zh: 我就在你刚才看过的地方
lines.en: I am exactly where you just looked
Speeding up does not help you
My hand is on your back
That was light, like a branch
Bone meets bone, and it is cold
One grab and you go weak
My fingers are long enough to reach you
You finally turned around
I do not need to look for this one
I know that way you back away
Keep retreating and you reach the trees
Once I have you, I do not let go
This blow makes no sound

lines.zh: 我的手臂从后面绕过来
lines.en: My arm comes around from behind
You flinched, so I know it hurt

lines.zh: 这不算快，只是你没看见
lines.en: That was not fast, you simply did not see it
The next one will be closer
Do not shout, no one is here
I appear between tree and tree

lines.zh: 先是影子，然后才是人形
lines.en: First a shadow, then a shape
This forest has always had me

lines.zh: 我从废弃的屋子里出来
lines.en: I come out of the abandoned house

lines.zh: 洞口的黑暗里多了一道轮廓
lines.en: A shape forms in the cave's dark
You did not hear me arrive

lines.zh: 我站在你灯照不到的地方
lines.en: I stand where your lamp does not reach

lines.zh: 夜里有我，你该早点回家
lines.en: I am out tonight, you should have gone home
I have no footsteps
The woods are quiet — perfect.
The air has gone a little colder

lines.zh: 我就站在那儿，等你发现
lines.en: I simply stand there, waiting to be noticed

lines.zh: 风把树叶吹开，露出了我
lines.en: The wind parts the leaves and reveals me
I rise upright out of the tree shadow.
I arrived long before you

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼就知道了
lines.en: One look back and you will know
I am nearing the lamp
Tonight you will remember me
Fire touches me and I shrink back

lines.zh: 我落下来时，关节错开了
lines.en: My joints slip as I land

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的动作慢了
lines.en: Water enters me, and my movement slows

lines.zh: 爆炸把林子照亮了，我讨厌光
lines.en: The blast lights the forest, and I hate light

lines.zh: 飞来的东西钉进了我的肩
lines.en: Something flying pinned my shoulder
That force nailed me in place
Hunger makes me thinner and slower

lines.zh: 闪电照亮了我，我无处可躲
lines.en: Lightning lit me up, and I had nowhere to hide

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，也没有影子
lines.en: No trees in the void, and no shadow
